description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerHelper class, which provides helper methods for managing user role permissions, including retrieving data group permissions and permission collections, and checking employee access rights within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to manage user role permissions and access checks in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Retrieves the user role manager instance from the service container.

methods.name: getEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Gets data group permissions without considering specific employee or entity.

methods.name: geEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Gets a collection of data group permissions without considering specific employee or entity.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions for a specific employee.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of data group permissions for a specific employee.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the given employee number matches the logged-in user's employee number.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Checks if an employee is accessible either by entity permissions or if it is the logged-in user.
